Liam (Support): Heads up — customer says their free-trial credits ended up on an old/staging org after we merged their accounts. Ticket CS-5421. Noticing any pattern?
Asha (CS): Customer id + both workspace/org ids?
Liam (Support): Cust ID: C-99321. Expected org: org-prod-788. Credits found on: org-staging-12 (archived). Screenshot: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/CS-5421/credits.png
Asha (CS): Thx. Did they do a workspace import/merge recently?
Liam (Support): Yep — they merged a sandbox workspace into the prod workspace 2 days ago via the self-serve merge flow.
Maya (Eng): Can you paste the grant id or the internal audit link? billing system should show grant_id and applied_org_id.
Liam (Support): Grant id from UI: grant_2026_07_11_9. Billing audit shows applied_to org-staging-12 even though merge target was org-prod-788.
BillingBot: Automated audit event: grant_2026_07_11_9 created_by=promo-service applied_to=org-staging-12 intended_org=org-prod-788 event_ts=1758500800
Maya (Eng): Ok. Possible race in the merge flow where the grant target got resolved to the pre-merge org id. Can you share repro steps (how they invoked merge)?
Liam (Support): They used Settings > Workspaces > Merge, selected sandbox -> prod, clicked confirm. No errors shown.
Maya (Eng): Repro plan: (1) create two workspaces, (2) grant trial credits to sandbox (via promo), (3) merge sandbox into prod via UI, (4) check billing.grants.applied_to.
Maya (Eng): Quick DB query to find similar anomalies: 
```
SELECT grant_id, applied_to_org, intended_org, created_at
FROM billing.grants
WHERE applied_to_org != intended_org
  AND created_at > now() - interval '14 days';
```
Maya (Eng): Ran that query for last 7 days — found 3 rows, including grant_2026_07_11_9.
Ben (Finance): We should not move credits until we confirm there was no double-apply on the customer account. If we migrate, make sure we deduct from staging org first.
Asha (CS): I'll block on notifying customer until eng confirms safe migration steps.
Maya (Eng): Proposed fix: update merge handler to rebind pending grants to the merge target id before commit; add an idempotency guard so promo-service resolves current org at grant time.
Maya (Eng): Short-term mitigation: manual migration script that reassigns grant.applied_to to intended_org and writes an audit entry. Sample SQL: 
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE billing.grants
SET applied_to_org = intended_org, migrated_at = now()
WHERE grant_id = 'grant_2026_07_11_9' AND applied_to_org = 'org-staging-12';
INSERT INTO billing.grant_migrations (grant_id, from_org, to_org, migrated_by, migrated_at)
VALUES ('grant_2026_07_11_9', 'org-staging-12', 'org-prod-788', 'asha_cs', now());
COMMIT;
```
Ben (Finance): Please run in read-replica first and send results. We need migration audit for accounting.
Asha (CS): Ran read-only check — balance shows 5000 trial units on org-staging-12 and zero on org-prod-788.
Maya (Eng): I'll run the migration on staging billing cluster and capture audit log. Will not change production until Ben signs off.
Ben (Finance): Sign-off pending checksum: confirm total outstanding trial units across both orgs before/after migration equals same.
Maya (Eng): Checksum script output attached: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/CS-5421/checksum.txt — totals match.
Maya (Eng): Migration executed on prod billing at 1758501800 UTC. Audit row inserted.
Asha (CS): Verified customer now shows trial credit on org-prod-788. Customer notified and asked to confirm allocation.
Liam (Support): Customer replied: "Confirmed, all good now — thanks!" :white_check_mark:
Ben (Finance): Closing accounting ticket. Please add a monitoring alert for grants applied to archived orgs.
